svg.title: Precision-recall evidence for an imbalanced XGBoost classifier
svg.desc: Two generated panels compare precision-recall curves for unweighted and class-weighted XGBoost models, then compare false positives, false negatives, and true positives at two thresholds.

cc:Work.dc:title: Precision-recall evidence for an imbalanced XGBoost classifier
cc:Work.dc:description: Generated two-panel chart comparing unweighted and class-weighted precision-recall curves and the test alert counts at default and validation-selected thresholds.
